New Huge Commission Comic set in the same universe as the previous comic The Pill, this time featuring Anna and Mako from Okusama wa Moto Yariman. Reina's left a special homemade cake behind for the girls, and they do say calories go straight to your chest after all~

Features breast expansion, hyper sizes, futanarization, mind break, impregnation and more~

Hope you enjoy it!
